stdyInfo.abstract: Model questions proposed by Eurostat for the 2022 wave of the EU Adult Education Survey, which national statistical institutes adapt into their own questionnaires. They ask adults about their household and background, labour status and job, access to guidance, participation in formal and non-formal education and training in the last 12 months (with details on the most recent formal activity and a randomly selected non-formal activity), obstacles to participation, informal learning, languages, health and household income.

varGrp.notes: Apart from the learning activities mentioned earlier, you can also deliberately acquire or improve knowledge and skills in a planned manner by self-learning or teaching yourself, whether at work or during your free time, alone or with others. Below is a list of various forms how this can be done. Or Apart from the learning activities mentioned earlier, you can also acquire or improve knowledge and skills on your own, outside of institutionalised education and training activities, either at work or during your free time. Yet, this learning must be planned beforehand and you must have goals for yourself regarding own efforts and outcomes. In being intentional and planned, such learning is distinguished from incidental or random learning, i.e. knowledge and skills that we acquire every day, without thinking much about it.
